title: Dependency resolved from a local path
description: package.json declares a `file:` dependency that points at a path on the build machine. The installed code is whatever sits at that path at build time, so the artifact is not reproducible from the manifest and a local edit ships without review.
remediation: Publish the package to a private registry, or use a workspace with a lockfile entry that records the resolved content.
limitation: It matches a `file:` dependency that points at a path on the build machine in the parsed package.json; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
